name: Pictogram
summary: A beat-locked flash-card catalogue: a square grid of discs and motif cells whose rows drift sideways, faceless geometric pictogram figures on a sun disc, huge Inter Tight capitals sliding out of masks, DM Mono meta and a progress HUD; one hue per chapter in five tones.

palette.use: the sky hue's t1: the default card ground and pattern fill
cream: type and figures on dark and mid hues; the end card
the sky hue's t4: ghost titles, done ticks
the sky hue's t0: hairlines and the panel
coral t2: the NEW tag, one accent per card (proposed)
sand t2: the accent on the dark ink chapter
type and figures on the light sand hue

type.emphasis: the hue and the scale of the title; a NEW tag in coral

banned: depth, 3D or isometric; dissolves, 3D camera moves, handheld shake, depth of field
faces or emotions on figures (not a cartoon)
outlines; gradients except the one light sweep
numbers as charts: numbers are labels
mascots, landmarks or logos in pattern cells
copying a real event's pictograms, emblem, slogan, pattern or colour names

sources.what: Lemo-Opuscar style No. 21 "Pictogram" (Pictogram Motion): STYLE.md, DEMO.md, style.json
sources.where: github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar styles/pictogram-motion; research notes docs/research/styles/five-skills.md, "Pictogram Motion"
sources.licence: MIT (code and docs); demo films and stills CC BY 4.0. The demo copies a real event's identity: its palette, mark, slogan and pattern art are not used; this palette is new (a coastal set). No code copied. Inter Tight and DM Mono are SIL OFL.
